source: Florida Department of Education, Membership by School by Grade (Survey 2)
notes: Final Survey 2 for all years except 2021-22, which FL DOE published as a preliminary Survey 2 snapshot (as of Dec 23, 2021). Years with a privacy-suppressed total are omitted for that school. Keyed by MSID; multi-campus charters reported under one MSID (e.g. KIPP Miami, 13-2332) carry the network trend, which each campus resolves through report_msid.
